USE USOnTimeProject
GO 

-- Create view for trip_data_green
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS gold.vw_FactOnTimeData
GO

CREATE VIEW gold.vw_FactOnTimeData
AS
SELECT
    result.*,
    result.filepath(1) AS yearfilter,
    result.filepath(2) AS monthfilter
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Gold/OnTimeReporting/year=*/month=*/*.parquet',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_RootFS',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    )
    WITH (
        OnTimeSKey INT,
        FlightDate DATE,
        AirlineCode VARCHAR(10),
        AirlineId INT,
        FlightNumber INT,
        OriginAirportId INT,
        OriginAirportCode VARCHAR(10),
        OriginStateCode VARCHAR(5),
        DestinationAirportId INT,
        DestinationAirportCode VARCHAR(10),
        DestinationStateCode VARCHAR(5),
        ScheduledDepartureTimeKey INT,
        ActualDepartureTimeKey INT,
        DepartureDelayInMinutes FLOAT,
        TaxiOutTimeInMinutes FLOAT,
        TaxiInTimeInMinutes FLOAT,
        ScheduledArrivalTimeKey INT,
        ActualArrivalTimeKey INT,
        ArrivalDelayInMinutes FLOAT,
        IsCancelled FLOAT,
        CancellationCode VARCHAR(5),
        IsDiverted FLOAT,
        EstimatedElapsedTimeInMinutes FLOAT,
        ActualElapsedTimeInMinutes FLOAT,
        TotalDelayInMinutes FLOAT,
        AirTime FLOAT,
        Distance FLOAT,
        AirlinesDelayInMinutes FLOAT,
        WeatherDelayInMinutes FLOAT,
        NasDelayInMinutes FLOAT,
        SecurityDelayInMinutes FLOAT,
        LateAircraftDelayInMinutes FLOAT
  ) AS [result]
GO

SELECT TOP(100) *
  FROM silver.vw_USOnTimeData
GO

select top 100 * from silver.vw_USOnTimeData 
where year='2022' and month ='01'

select count(1) from silver.vw_USOnTimeData 
where year='2022' and month ='01'
